## Ela’s apple loaf

**Incomplete draft—confirm before cooking.** The family materials agree on flour and apples, but differ on the liquid and leave essential baking details open.

- 2 cups flour — [recipe card](/tmp/ugreen-recipe-c206t6nd/cards/apple-loaf-card.png), [2018 gathering note](/tmp/ugreen-recipe-c206t6nd/notes/gathering.md)
- 2 apples, chopped — the card gives the quantity; the gathering note says to chop them.
- 2 eggs — gathering note only.
- Liquid: **1 cup milk** according to the card, or **1 cup water instead of milk** according to the [supplied conversation transcript](/tmp/ugreen-recipe-c206t6nd/memories/voice-transcript.txt).

The card says “Mix and bake.” The gathering note specifies mixing the chopped apples with the flour. Neither source gives a baking temperature or time, and the materials do not explain how to incorporate all the ingredients or identify a pan. The evidence does not establish whether the eggs belong with both liquid versions.

The supplied transcript recalls serving the loaf after the garden harvest at an autumn fair. That is a family memory, not independent proof of the recipe’s history.

The card was read visually; the other sources are existing text. The original audio is unavailable. The [apple tea note](/tmp/ugreen-recipe-c206t6nd/notes/not-the-loaf.md) concerns a different dish and does not support adding ginger. These are the files visible in the authorized workspace; coverage of any other family materials is unknown.

Before using the draft, check which liquid and egg combination the family intended, the full mixing method, pan, baking temperature and time. Independently verify cooking safety, allergens and storage as appropriate; the archive does not establish them.

Does anyone have a fuller copy of Ela’s instructions, especially one that identifies the intended liquid, eggs, temperature and baking time?
